comment: Fig. 16 of astrolabe-site's observatory plates (lab/observatories/plates.json, picdumidi-1, at cce8da1), made by its scripts/observatories/. The plate is a 1000-unit square; box is the art's x, y, width, height in it. The rock runs off both sides of the square: its left fades to paper in the art, its right is cut and wants a clipping edge.

alt: A print of the Pic du Midi Observatory on its rock face in the Pyrenees, lit by the astrolabe's sun
